approach: THIS PROPOSAL: radiative wire-grid ENZ stack (reference row)
mechanism: Mirror-backed stack of 7-15 free-standing Cu wire grids (wires || B0) acting as a leaky ENZ slab; axion-driven E_z radiates through the open face into external optics; tuned by common grid spacing d at fixed pitch
readout_and_receiver_count: External quasi-optics; Gaussian receiving mode per 10x10 cm2 tile (100 tiles per m2 in the forecast); linear (N_sys=10 h nu) or photon counting
boost_or_form_factor_scale: b_pk ~ 0.613 Q_mat^(4/3) (slab estimate); discrete-sheet designs b ~ 1e3

mechanism: Resonant axion-plasmon conversion when m_a = omega_p of a wire metamaterial; omega_p^2 = 2pi/(s^2 log(s/d)) set by wire spacing; tuning by moving planes of wires in one direction and by swapping inserts
mass_range_meV: 0.035-0.4 (projected); soft upper limit ~100 GHz from 10 um wires / 3 mm spacing
readout_and_receiver_count: Antennas or pickup loops inside the structure + low-noise microwave amplifier (critically coupled, kappa=0.5); localized readout
boost_or_form_factor_scale: Field enhancement ~Q inside bulk; independent of boundaries ('same for a medium surrounded by vacuum')
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: none (projection: DFSZ over 35-400 ueV in 6 yr with T_sys = m_a)
overlap_with_proposal: Establishes tunable wire-plasma conversion and plane-spacing tuning. Readout was internal antennas, not radiation through a face.
source_locations: abstract p1; Eqs.(4a),(6),(7) p3; tuning & inserts p4; antenna p4; reach p5

approach: Plasma haloscope theory and baseline (ALPHA consortium)
mechanism: Wire-metamaterial plasma; signal P_s = kappa G V Q rho g^2 B^2/m_a (Eq.23); thin-wire Q ~ 2 (r/delta)(log(a/2pi r)+F) (Eq.59); omega_p from Eq.(53)-(54); ASE skin depth Eq.(61)
mass_range_meV: 0.021-0.19 (5-45 GHz Stage II); 'multiple antennas would extend DFSZ reach to 50 GHz'
readout_and_receiver_count: Single port/monopole antenna into HEMT (Stage I) or quantum-limited amplifier (Stage II); size restricted to < sqrt(Q_U) lambda for single-antenna readout; multiple antennas needed for very large systems
boost_or_form_factor_scale: Loss-limited transport: travelling waves decay over ~sqrt(omega/Gamma_p) lambda_c (Sec. II.C, Fig. 2); unloaded Q > 1e4 for Cu below ~30 GHz (Fig. 4)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: none (projection: DFSZ 5-45 GHz, 13 T, 35 cm x 75 cm)
overlap_with_proposal: Already notes that a sufficiently large plasma needs no cavity (radiative losses subdominant, Sec. VI p18) and free-space wire-array measurements (Sec. IV.A). No radiative/optical readout is developed.
source_locations: Eq.(17) p5 (multiple antennas); Sec. II.C p6; Eqs.(53)-(61) pp9-10; Sec. VI p18; Fig. 16 & p20

mechanism: Tunable multi-rod resonators (Rinnegan ring-nested rotation; tunable symmetric lattice); effective plasma frequency = lowest TM mode
readout_and_receiver_count: Resonator output antenna; several resonators each matched to a flux-pumped JPA band; single-quadrature readout
status: Infrastructure integrated, magnet pending; validation via dark-photon run with prototype (Sec. II, p3)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: none yet; projection approaches KSVZ 10-20 GHz
overlap_with_proposal: Future phases to 50 GHz with ~100 um wires at ~1 mm spacing; above ~20 GHz plans kinetic-inductance down-conversion and single-photon detectors (Sec. IV). No optical/free-space extraction discussed.
source_locations: abstract p1; Sec. II.A-B p3; Table I p9; Sec. IV.A-B pp9-10

mechanism: Free-space S21 of wire-array slabs (horn-to-horn, Drude slab fit); interpenetrating-lattice translation; spiral-arm rotation; rotating obround rods (ENZ)
readout_and_receiver_count: VNA with horn antennas (Wooten) or cavity ports (others)
boost_or_form_factor_scale: omega_p agrees with Belov theory to 0.1% (Wooten); tuning 16% (Kowitt), ~25% (Lindahl, form factor ~0.45-0.5), 26% abstract / 28% text 9.30-12.14 GHz (Balafendiev)
overlap_with_proposal: Wooten already treats a finite wire-array slab in free space as a complex dielectric slab (Eqs.3-4) and notes an actual resonator would be enclosed (p6). Tuning ranges are far below the ~3x spacing change per octave required here.
source_locations: Wooten abstract p1, Eqs.(3) p3, p6; Kowitt abstract p1, p6; Lindahl abstract p1, pp3-4; Balafendiev abstract p1, p6

mechanism: Mirror + N parallel dielectric disks in B || surfaces; coherent interface emission; boost beta^2 = P/P0; Area Law (integral of beta^2 over frequency ~ conserved)
readout_and_receiver_count: Emission perpendicular to disks collected by parabolic mirror/horn into one receiver (HEMT or quantum-limited); Gaussian-beam coupling studied in 3D
boost_or_form_factor_scale: beta ~ 275 over 50 MHz with 20 disks (Caldwell Fig.); beta^2 > 1e4 needed, > 5e4 possible with 80 disks; B^2 A = 100 T^2 m^2 (9 T, 1.25 m disks)
overlap_with_proposal: Open, mirror-backed multilayer with external optics and few receivers is established. 3D: geometric form factor reduces power by up to 30% vs 1D; total vs Gaussian-antenna power distinguished (w0 ~ diameter/3).
source_locations: Caldwell abstract p1, Fig.1 p1, Eq.(4) p2, p4 Eq.(9); Millar Area Law p6 & Sec.4 p25, App. A; MADMAX:2019pub pp10-12; Knirck abstract, pp4-7

mechanism: Closed booster: Al mirror + 3 sapphire disks (1 mm, 200 mm dia.) in 1.6 T Morpurgo dipole
readout_and_receiver_count: Lens + taper into TE11 (~84% of axion power in TE11), 50 Ohm line, room-temperature LNA chain (T_sys ~ 230 K added noise)
boost_or_form_factor_scale: beta^2 ~ 2e3 scale (sensitivity formula normalised to beta^2 = 2e3)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: |g| ~ 2e-11 GeV^-1, 95% CL, rho_a = 0.3 GeV/cm3, 14.5 days (not in 0.25-4 meV)
overlap_with_proposal: Demonstrates the open-booster + optical-coupling chain experimentally at ~77-80 ueV.
source_locations: abstract p1; Eq.(1) p2; setup p2; Fig. limit (TeX source l.144-155)

mechanism: Non-resonant emission from a magnetized conducting surface; spherical dish focuses emission to centre
readout_and_receiver_count: Single broadband detector at the focus
status: Concept (2013); later realised by several groups
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: none in 0.25-4 meV for g_agg (see BREAD row)
overlap_with_proposal: Origin of the P0 normalisation and of 'broad face into one detector'.

mechanism: Broadband conversion on a cylindrical barrel parallel to solenoid field; coaxial parabolic reflector focuses onto one photosensor
readout_and_receiver_count: Single photosensor of mm-scale area (requirement NEP < 1e-20 W/rtHz or DCR < 1e-3 Hz); pilots: coaxial horn + RF receiver
boost_or_form_factor_scale: beta^2 ~ 1 (non-resonant); axion sensitivity needs 10 T and 10 m2 barrel
status: Pilots running (room temperature, 3.9 T for ALPs)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: GigaBREAD 2025: ALP limit at 44-52 ueV, 90% CL (numeric value not given in abstract/text; not extracted); none in 0.25-4 meV
overlap_with_proposal: Large area focused onto a single detector at THz is established; Rydberg single-photon detector proposed for 0.1-10 meV (Banerjee).
source_locations: BREAD abstract p1, Fig.1 p2, TeX l.160, l.325; GigaBREAD abstract p1; Banerjee abstract p1

mechanism: Mirror-backed stack of dielectric layers (magnetized phased array) coupled in near field to a semi-open Fabry-Perot resonator; separates dielectric boost from resonant storage
readout_and_receiver_count: Phased-array antenna receiver (design); prototype: WR-137 horn + cryogenic HEMT
boost_or_form_factor_scale: P_a ~ g^2 B^2 A_eta Q_L beta/(1+beta); prototype A_eta ~ 0.61 A_phys, FWHM ~ 20 MHz
status: Prototype result (2026); full design in preparation
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: g_agg < 9.7e-12 GeV^-1 at 28.54 ueV, 90% CL, 6.887-6.918 GHz, 0.59 T permanent magnet, 36 h
overlap_with_proposal: Open mirror-backed multilayer with resonant enhancement and external receiver is established (dielectric, not conductor plasma).
source_locations: 2026 design abstract p1, TeX l.151-188; prototype abstract p1, TeX l.159-312; 2023 abstract p1

mechanism: Multiple-quantum-well 2DEG magnetoplasma with tunable ENZ resonance; tuning by orientation in B; axion-induced radiation emitted from the cavity surface
readout_and_receiver_count: Focuser + one photodetector; optional mirror redirects emission from both faces toward the detector
boost_or_form_factor_scale: Emitted-power enhancement ~1e4; W = 3-5 cm, D = 2-20 mm, B = 36-50 T, dark 0.1-1 mHz, eta = 7-35%, 300 d
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: none (projected to reach QCD band at meV)
overlap_with_proposal: Closest prior art: a radiating ENZ/plasma converter, mirror-backed, read through its face by a single photodetector, in the same mass decade. Differences: semiconductor 2DEG vs metallic wire grids; non-mechanical tuning; cm-scale area.
source_locations: abstract p1; Fig.1 & p2; boost with mirror p3; Table I p5

mechanism: Axion mixes with material polariton (AQ in AF topological insulator; optical-phonon polariton); conversion at boundaries to propagating photons; loss-limited optimal thickness
readout_and_receiver_count: Photon counting; area (0.1 m)^2 chosen from etendue: A < 1e6 A' in vacuum, otherwise multiple detectors (Marsh Eq.33)
boost_or_form_factor_scale: Loss-dominated beta(omega_j) (Eq.4.50); d_opt ~ Gamma^(-1/3) (Eq.4.51; Marsh Eq.34) => beta_max ~ Gamma^(-2/3), i.e. power ~ Q^(4/3) (implied)
overlap_with_proposal: The depth optimum and Q^(4/3) scaling of a lossy resonant slab are already derived in this framework; the etendue/single-detector argument is in Marsh.
source_locations: Schutte-Engel abstract p2, Eqs.(4.50)-(4.51) pp62-64; Marsh abstract p1, Eqs.(33)-(34) p8

approach: In-medium absorption (phonon polaritons, magnons, dielectric targets)
mechanism: Absorption of axion DM into in-medium excitations in a B field, rate fixed by the dielectric function; calorimetric (phonon/quasiparticle) readout
readout_and_receiver_count: Phonon/photon/magnon sensors inside target (no free-space optics)
source_locations: Mitridate abstract p1; Berlin & Trickle abstract p1

mechanism: Periodic dielectric multilayer converts DM to photons, focused to a single-photon detector (SNSPD)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: Dark photon only: epsilon >~ 1e-12 excluded at ~0.7-0.8 eV (no axion limit)
overlap_with_proposal: Multilayer + focusing + single-photon counting, at much higher mass.
source_locations: Baryakhtar abstract p1; Chiles abstract p1

mechanism: Resonant cavity (multi-cavity/large-cavity designs) in high B field; quasi-optical coupling (horns and mirrors) to KID array
readout_and_receiver_count: KIDs via quasi-optics (incoherent; NEP target ~1e-20 W/rtHz)
status: In preparation at Canfranc (2022); KID development (2024)
overlap_with_proposal: Only other dedicated effort inside our lower band; shares quasi-optical KID readout but uses cavities.
source_locations: abstract p2; TeX sec. on detectors (NEP)

approach: Cavity haloscopes at the highest masses (ORGAN, QUAX)
mechanism: Tunable cavities (ORGAN rectangular cavity; QUAX OFHC Cu at 30 mK, 8 T)
best_achieved_limit_in_or_near_0.25-4meV: ORGAN 1b: g >= 4e-12 GeV^-1 excluded, 95%; QUAX: g < 0.882e-13 GeV^-1, 90% CL. Highest-mass haloscope exclusion in AxionLimits ends at 111.9 ueV
overlap_with_proposal: Benchmarks the mass reach of existing haloscopes (all < 0.12 meV).
source_locations: Quiskamp 2024 PRL abstract p1; QUAX abstract p1; AxionLimits Haloscopes_Combined file

mechanism: PBG lattice (as few as 1-2 periods) suppresses TE modes in tunable resonators
overlap_with_proposal: Alternative to metallic walls for wire/rod resonators; ALPHA cites PBG option.
